chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shammun, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Asamm, from Mismāʿ, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام.

That Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام was brought a zindiq, so he struck his neck. Then it was said to him: he has abundant wealth, so for whom is his wealth to be assigned? He said: for his children, his heirs, and his wife.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Imam Ali عليه السلام in his authority as ruler and judge
key_terms.زِنْدِيقٍ: a heretic or zindiq brought for judgment
key_terms.مَالًا: property or wealth owned by the person

ai.seo_question: To whom does the wealth of a zindiq go according to Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This report narrates a legal ruling from Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام concerning the disposition of the wealth of a zindiq after execution. It indicates that his property is given to his children, heirs, and wife, reflecting a ruling related to inheritance and judicial treatment in cases of apostasy or zandaqah.
